name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Create an API key in incident.io under **Settings → API keys** with at least the **View data** permission.

name: catalogTypes
label: Catalog types to index (optional)
help: Index the entries of these catalog types as **Catalog Entry** objects, so you can filter incidents by them and open a dashboard for each one. Pick from the catalog types in your incident.io account, or type a name exactly as it appears under **Catalog**. Leave empty to index no catalog entries.
